mapper.select: SELECT pk_id, id, tenant_id, app_name, logo_url, primary_color, login_slogan, support_phone, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted FROM tenant_config WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_config( id, tenant_id, app_name, logo_url, primary_color, login_slogan, support_phone, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{appName}, #{logoUrl}, #{primaryColor}, #{loginSlogan}, #{supportPhone}, #{isDeleted}, #{gmtCreated}, #{gmtModified}, #{gmtDeleted} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE app_name = VALUES(app_name), logo_url = VALUES(logo_url), primary_color = VALUES(primary_color), login_slogan = VALUES(login_slogan), support_phone = VALUES(support_phone), gmt_modified = VALUES(gmt_modified)
